one_line: Aspen Plus thermodynamic simulation and sensitivity analysis of a novel trigeneration (CCHP) cycle with two-phase expanders and compressors, targeting heating/cooling end-uses such as building climate control, food-industry sterilization, and cold storage; no continuous-production sector is empirically demonstrated.
